enforcement_context: California Building Code Chapter 11B is enforced by local building officials for permitted work and, through Civil Code 54-55.56 and the Unruh Act (Civil Code 51, 52: $4,000 minimum statutory damages per occasion), by private construction-related accessibility claims. rules.title: Path of travel upgraded with alterations (CBC)
rules.summary: Alterations require path-of-travel upgrades; at or below the valuation threshold the spend is capped at 20% of adjusted construction cost, above it full compliance unless unreasonable hardship.

scoping.text: Permitted alterations, structural repairs or additions.

question.prompt: When you remodeled under a permit, was the path of travel (primary entrance, route, restrooms, drinking fountains, public phones, signs) upgraded, spending at least 20% of the adjusted construction cost when the project was at or under the valuation threshold?

rules.notes: CBC 11B-202.4 Exception 8. DSA 2026 valuation threshold: $209,208 (projects submitted after 2026-01-19), https://www.dgs.ca.gov/DSA/News/Page-Content/Division-of-the-State-Architect-News-List-Folder/Valuation-Threshold-Update-for-2026. Above the threshold CBC requires full path-of-travel compliance unless the enforcing agency finds unreasonable hardship, which is stricter than the federal 20% cap.
